mapper.select: select as period, sum(created_count) as created_count, sum(completed_count) as completed_count from ( select created_at as event_time, 1 as created_count, 0 as completed_count from work_order where created_at >= #{startDate} and created_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) union all select completed_at as event_time, 0 as created_count, 1 as completed_count from work_order where completed_at >= #{startDate} and completed_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) ) events group by period order by period
select fault_level, count(*) as count from fault_record where reported_at >= #{startDate} and reported_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) group by fault_level
select status, count(*) as count from equipment group by status

select case when #{role} = 'ADMIN' then (select count(*) from equipment) else null end as equipment_total_count, case when #{role} = 'MAINTAINER' then 0 else (select count(*) from inspection_task t where t.task_date = current_date and t.status in ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') and (#{role} = 'ADMIN' or t.inspector_id = #{userId})) end as today_pending_inspection_count, case when #{role} = 'MAINTAINER' then 0 else (select count(*) from inspection_task t where t.task_date = current_date and t.status = 'COMPLETED' and (#{role} = 'ADMIN' or t.inspector_id = #{userId})) end as today_completed_inspection_count, case when #{role} = 'ADMIN' then (select count(*) from equipment where status in ('FAULT', 'IN_REPAIR')) when #{role} = 'INSPECTOR' then (select count(distinct f.equipment_id) from fault_record f where f.reporter_id = #{userId} and f.status != 'CLOSED') else (select count(distinct w.equipment_id) from work_order w where w.maintainer_id = #{userId} and w.status not in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')) end as abnormal_equipment_count, (select count(*) from work_order w join fault_record f on f.id = w.fault_record_id where w.status not in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') and (#{role} = 'ADMIN' or (#{role} = 'MAINTAINER' and w.maintainer_id = #{userId}) or (#{role} = 'INSPECTOR' and f.reporter_id = #{userId}))) as pending_work_order_count, (select count(*) from work_order w join fault_record f on f.id = w.fault_record_id where w.priority = 'URGENT' and w.status not in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') and (#{role} = 'ADMIN' or (#{role} = 'MAINTAINER' and w.maintainer_id = #{userId}) or (#{role} = 'INSPECTOR' and f.reporter_id = #{userId}))) as urgent_work_order_count, coalesce((select round(100.0 * sum(w.status = 'COMPLETED') / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) from work_order w join fault_record f on f.id = w.fault_record_id where w.status != 'CANCELLED' and (#{role} = 'ADMIN' or (#{role} = 'MAINTAINER' and w.maintainer_id = #{userId}) or (#{role} = 'INSPECTOR' and f.reporter_id = #{userId}))), 0) as work_order_completion_rate
